page_index=0
page_limit=20
all_results=[]
while True:
    res = apis.amazon.search_products(query='', product_type='area rug', max_price=150, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-rating')
    print('page', page_index, 'len', len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    all_results.extend(res)
    page_index += 1
print('total_results', len(all_results))
# Filter trusted sellers
trusted_results=[r for r in all_results if r.get('seller_id') in set(trusted_seller_ids) and r.get('inventory_quantity',0)>0 and r.get('price',0)<=150]
print('trusted_results', len(trusted_results))
# sort candidates by rating desc, price asc, delivery_days asc
candidates=sorted(trusted_results, key=lambda r:(-r.get('rating',0), r.get('price',0), r.get('delivery_days',0)))
print('top10_candidates (product_id,seller_id,price,rating,delivery_days,inventory)', [(c['product_id'], c['seller_id'], c['price'], c['rating'], c['delivery_days'], c['inventory_quantity']) for c in candidates[:10]])
